categories.main_business_segments: Easy Click Worldwide Network Technology Co., Ltd primarily operates in mobile internet advertising, including design, production, publishing, and agency services. Its business segments encompass integrated overseas marketing services, digital marketing, advertising monetization, AI digital creativity, BI decision-making, and CI intelligent multi-cloud management. The company serves various industries such as e-commerce, mobile applications, gaming, new energy, and high-end manufacturing, providing comprehensive marketing and digital services for Chinese enterprises expanding globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced advertising technology integrated deeply with AI capabilities, including real-time and offline massive data computing frameworks, global network acceleration, distributed messaging, intelligent channel customer rating, and AI-driven programmatic advertising platforms. It has developed proprietary platforms like KreadoAI (AIGC digital marketing creation), CyberMedia, CyberTargeter, CyberCreative, CyberData, and zMaticoo SDK for programmatic direct media access. The firm emphasizes AI model retraining, multi-cloud computing, AI recommendation algorithms, and automated intelligent ad placement to enhance marketing precision and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Easy Click serves a broad customer base including large internet companies such as Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance, SHEIN, MiHoYo, Didi, and Ctrip, as well as emerging clients in new consumption, short video, and AI tool sectors. Its markets span cross-border e-commerce, gaming, entertainment, tools, cultural tourism, new energy, and manufacturing industries. The company supports Chinese enterprises in their global expansion, focusing on overseas emerging markets and providing tailored marketing solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in over 200 countries and regions. It has subsidiaries and operational centers in key locations including China (Xi'an, Beijing, Shanghai), Hong Kong, the United States, Japan, India, Germany, South Korea, Singapore, Italy, Spain, and the Cayman Islands. Its services cover both domestic (China) and international markets, with overseas revenue accounting for approximately 86% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Easy Click operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital advertising supply chain. It acts as an intermediary between advertisers (clients) and media platforms, managing advertising campaigns, media buying, and programmatic ad placements. The company also provides technology platforms and data analytics services that support both upstream media inventory and downstream advertiser needs, positioning itself as a comprehensive marketing service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes AI-driven innovation, focusing on integrating AI, big data, and cloud computing to enhance marketing efficiency and product differentiation. Key R&D initiatives include the development of large-scale AI models for bid rate prediction, AI-powered creative content generation (KreadoAI), intelligent multi-cloud management, and programmatic advertising platforms. It collaborates with leading cloud and AI model providers like Google Cloud, Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure, Alibaba Cloud, and Tencent Cloud, and invests in AI knowledge bases and customer service automation to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Easy Click generates revenue primarily through performance-based advertising services, including effect advertising marketing services and advertising sales agency services. Revenue is recognized based on specific user actions such as downloads, activations, and registrations, with pricing models tied to these outcomes. The company also earns income from digital marketing solutions, AI creative content services, and data analytics platforms, with a small portion from other business activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Easy Click is positioned as a leading independent third-party advertising platform in the Chinese overseas marketing service sector. It competes with other digital marketing and advertising technology firms by leveraging its deep AI integration, extensive global media partnerships (including Google, Meta, TikTok, and AppLovin), and a broad client base. Its strategic focus on AI and programmatic advertising differentiates it in a competitive landscape characterized by rapid technological evolution and increasing demand for intelligent marketing solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Easy Click reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.55 billion, representing an 18.83% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 231.8 million, up 6.81%, with net profit excluding non-recurring items growing 30.10%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 5.77 billion, a 23.55% increase from the previous year, and operating cash flow improved significantly by 219.29%. The firm maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by expanding global client engagement and technological advancements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Easy Click emphasizes its unique value proposition of combining advanced AI technology with extensive global media resources to deliver precise, efficient, and scalable marketing solutions for Chinese enterprises going global. Its proprietary AI-driven platforms enable rapid creative content generation, intelligent audience targeting, and real-time bidding optimization, resulting in cost-effective and high-ROI advertising campaigns. The company’s comprehensive service ecosystem, including digital marketing, BI decision support, and multi-cloud management, offers differentiated, benchmarked, and intelligent full-chain overseas marketing services that support clients’ internationalization and localization strategies.
